pre: CREATE TABLE ice.ns.t40 (id INT, st STRUCT<v: TIMESTAMP_NTZ, n: INT>, c STRUCT<v: TIMESTAMP, n: INT>) USING iceberg TBLPROPERTIES ('format-version'='2', 'write.delete.mode'='merge-on-read', 'write.update.mode'='merge-on-read', 'write.merge.mode'='merge-on-read')
Australia/Lord_Howe.sql: MERGE INTO ice.ns.t40 t USING (SELECT id + 50 AS id FROM ice.ns.b) s ON t.id = s.id WHEN NOT MATCHED BY SOURCE THEN UPDATE SET t.st = CASE WHEN t.id = 1 THEN t.st ELSE t.c END

INSERT INTO ice.ns.t46 VALUES (1, named_struct('v', TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2026-01-02 03:04:05.123456', 'n', 1)), (2, named_struct('v', TIMESTAMP_NTZ '2026-01-02 03:04:05.123456', 'n', 2))
Australia/Lord_Howe.sql: MERGE INTO ice.ns.t46 t USING (SELECT id + 9 AS id, st FROM ice.ns.a UNION ALL SELECT id + 19 AS id, st FROM ice.ns.b) s ON t.id = s.id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.st = s.st WHEN NOT MATCHED AND s.id % 2 = 0 THEN INSERT (id, st) VALUES (s.id, s.st) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, st) VALUES (s.id + 100, s.st)
